statement: For the geometric A5 acting on the twelve-vertex sphere, every nonidentity discrete pure mapping class x has full procyclic closure Zhat, and that closure meets the actual pure profinite A5 centralizer trivially. For the explicit F9 word w, its closure already meets the centralizer of beta=(12)(45) trivially, because w belongs to the actual discrete A4 centralizer and A4 together with beta generates A5.

notes: Pure sphere mapping classes embed in pure plane braids by the exact configuration normalization. The faithful Artin action and maximal-syllable coefficient proof give a separating family of integral upper-unitriangular representations. Taking one block for each element of A5 makes its actual conjugation action a block permutation. For a discrete x which does not commute with the selected finite element, the logarithm commutator is one nonzero rational matrix. In every Q_p coordinate, centrality of x^u forces u_p times that same matrix to vanish, hence all u_p vanish. This excludes the entire concrete Zhat direction from F9, while making no claim that all residual-centralizer elements lie in closures of discrete cyclic subgroups. The exact C3 descent model is retained separately in code/part_a/second_a4_c3_attack.py. Its numerical Magnus exploration has not produced a certified smaller separating quotient and is not used in this proof. The explicit basepoint transport is z_*=-i(sqrt(phi+2)+phi) to 5+z_* to 5+4i along the full A4 orbit. The exact formula certificate passed 484 maximal-syllable cases, two actual pure Artin substitution compositions, eleven logarithm power identities, 180 A5 block conjugations, 60 block products, and finite reductions modulo p^2 for p=2,3,5,7,11. This checks the displayed formulas and does not claim a computed separating truncation for w.
